2609.36392.title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
2609.36392.paper_summary: In diseases where clinical guidelines are incomplete, contested, or mutually contradictory, knowledge completeness and dynamic conflict-aware synthesis are two safety-critical properties that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems do not provide. Therefore, we present \sysname, an adaptive retrieval calibration clinical question-answering agent for ME/CFS, a disease where diagnostic frameworks coexist and major guidelines actively contradict each other on treatment. ARCagent contributes three components. First, a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base with a structured inter-guideline conflict registry spanning all active ME/CFS diagnostic frameworks. Second, a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks retrieved evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. Third, a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, avoiding systematic underestimation averaging 10.1 percentage points caused by keyword matching. ARCagent achieves 95.3%, outperforming all base LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/ARCagent.
2609.36392.paper_summary_zh: 在臨床指導方針不完整、存在爭議或相互矛盾的疾病中，知識的完整性和動態衝突意識合成是標準增強檢索生成系統所不具備的兩個安全關鍵特性。<lb/>因此，我們提出了\sysname，一個針對ME/CFS的自適應檢索校準臨床問答代理，這是一種診斷框架共存且主要指導方針在治療上積極矛盾的疾病。<lb/>ARCagent貢獻了三個組件。<lb/>首先，一個包含1,706個片段、10個來源的知識庫，擁有一個結構化的指導方針間衝突登記，涵蓋所有活躍的ME/CFS診斷框架。<lb/>其次，一個衝突意識的檢索校準管道，使用查詢特定的焦點和衝突信號重新排名檢索到的證據。<lb/>第三，一個由LLM-as-Judge評分的基準，避免了由關鍵字匹配造成的系統性低估，平均低10.1個百分點。<lb/>ARCagent達到了95.3%的準確率，超越了所有基礎LLM。<lb/>代碼可在https://github.com/Yukyin/ARCagent獲得。
